description: Record a failure and the recovery that worked, so a later session can skip the dead end. Call it after any user-assisted recovery or non-obvious workaround. All four fields are required and validated — a vague entry is worse than none, because it costs context on every future lookup.

category.description: What kind of problem this was.

failure.description: What went wrong, concretely. e.g. 'Clicking Save did nothing because the form was still validating.'

pattern.description: The reusable rule for next time. e.g. 'Wait for the validation spinner to clear before clicking Save.'

recovery.description: What actually resolved it, as steps someone could repeat.

shared.description: Write to the shared team store instead of local, if one is configured.

url_pattern.description: URL substring this applies to, so it can be matched to a page later.

name: memory_record
